author: Goodenough, Ward H.
title: Gradual and quantum changes in the history of Chuukese (Trukese) phonology
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (JSTOR PDF in Downloads). Compares the vowels of Kiribati (Bingham 1908), Woleaian (Sohn & Tawerilmang 1976) and the Romónum dialect of Chuukese (Dyen 1949; Goodenough & Sugita 1980) to argue that change is gradual phonetically and abrupt phonemically. PMc kept the five POc vowels, POc *u having a central [ɨ] and a back [u] allophone (Dyen 1949: 431-432); Woleaian and Chuukese made them separate phonemes, Kiribati merged [ɨ] with i (p. 94). Chuukese changes in §§2.3.1-2.3.9 with 126 numbered cognate sets in the Appendix (pp. 104-113). Chuukese vowels written i ú u e é o á a ó (IPA i ɨ u e ə o æ a ɔ).
